authority: Canonical requirement records; generated Markdown is a readable view. Owner review is required for scope or authority changes.

evidence_catalog.title: Accepted scope and repository orientation
evidence_catalog.observed: The repository describes per-object crop classification, runtime/experiment separation, and four coding roles.
evidence_catalog.limits: Written intent establishes scope, not enforcement.

evidence_catalog.title: Typed contracts
evidence_catalog.observed: Strict Pydantic records define the core entities, forbid extra fields, and validate several value relationships.
evidence_catalog.limits: Current records do not establish authenticated certification, approval, schema migration, or every-ingress enforcement.

evidence_catalog.title: Guided setup and CLI
evidence_catalog.observed: Guided fixture setup and a simulated remote control API are exercised in the local suite.
evidence_catalog.limits: No live LiteLLM setup or deployed guided-to-runtime acceptance; prompt rules are not capability isolation.

evidence_catalog.title: Project and infrastructure templates
evidence_catalog.observed: Object templates, deployment examples, and readable navigation are present; ten YAML files were previously parsed.
evidence_catalog.limits: Parsing does not validate OpenTofu providers, template containment, deployment readiness, or usable endpoints.

evidence_catalog.title: Dataset behavior
evidence_catalog.observed: Local tests exercise label exceptions, duplicates, splits, provenance, idempotency, overwrite rejection, and selected artifact tampering.
evidence_catalog.limits: BigQuery/GCS adapter doubles do not prove live publication, retention, role denials, source snapshots, or concurrent recovery.

evidence_catalog.title: Trainer and actual DINOv3 integration
evidence_catalog.observed: Actual DINOv3 architecture with generated local weights passes frozen/selected-layer gradients, patch pooling, training, portable reload, evaluation, and heatmap checks. The layer-layout fix is committed as 749b3e5.
evidence_catalog.limits: Generated random weights do not establish pretrained defect quality, GPU/multi-GPU training, or production calibration. The older end-to-end fixture substitutes a tiny model.

evidence_catalog.title: Runtime release gates
evidence_catalog.observed: Local tests check ordered stages, failed-gate stopping, exact digest use, and handshake result requirements.
evidence_catalog.limits: Mocked gates cannot issue a trustworthy live certification. The monolithic certify wrapper currently builds, conflicting with restricted Certifier authority.

evidence_catalog.title: Control-plane state and admission
evidence_catalog.observed: Local tests cover persistence before start, selected idempotency, budget rejection, digest reuse, simulated job recovery, and API callbacks.
evidence_catalog.limits: Client runtime overrides/rates remain trust gaps; CAS, crash/concurrency safety, per-operation authorization, and no-build effect interception are not proved.

evidence_catalog.title: Durable workflow design
evidence_catalog.observed: The workflow dispatches and polls Vertex independently of an LLM session.
evidence_catalog.limits: No deployed workflow acceptance. Current timeout/poll-error paths mark failure without canceling/reconciling the job; running is recorded before observed running.

evidence_catalog.title: MLflow tracking and registration
evidence_catalog.observed: A real local SQLite-backed MLflow registry test checks candidate reuse; authentication/resume paths use simulated service behavior.
evidence_catalog.limits: No configured cloud MLflow service acceptance, protected-alias denial, or live lineage/registration recovery.

evidence_catalog.title: Promotion and rollback
evidence_catalog.observed: Local checks cover missing approval text, ledger history, promotion/rollback, and selected alias compensation on deployment failure.
evidence_catalog.limits: Approver strings are not authenticated human consent; readiness, traffic, concurrent releases, crash recovery, and live rollback are unverified.

evidence_catalog.title: Ray Serve packaging and inference
evidence_catalog.observed: Typed local inference/decode checks pass; acceptance notes record an earlier local Ray HTTP fixture predictor.
evidence_catalog.limits: A fixture predictor does not prove a trained DINOv3 model on GKE. Startup resolves champion instead of immutable approved version; live serving/auth/load gates remain open.

evidence_catalog.title: Structured telemetry
evidence_catalog.observed: JSON context logging and optional OTLP log export exist; the GPU probe emitted correlated stages in Cloud Logging.
evidence_catalog.limits: No complete tracing/metrics, secret-redaction, buffering, or live Loki-delivery acceptance.

evidence_catalog.title: Failure ownership
evidence_catalog.observed: Selected runtime failures are assigned an owner/retryability; the DINOv3 layer bug was corrected in trainer code.
evidence_catalog.limits: Complete taxonomy and enforcement of authorized recovery actions need additional proof.

evidence_catalog.title: Agent roles and hooks
evidence_catalog.observed: Four custom roles and three direct role-guard tests exist.
evidence_catalog.limits: Actual harness invocation is unverified; regex checks do not prevent SDK/interpreter/indirect effects or provide filesystem/cloud isolation.

evidence_catalog.title: Deployment and IAM templates
evidence_catalog.observed: Templates describe GCS, service identities, Cloud Run/SQL, Workflows, GKE/KubeRay, and configured integration endpoints.
evidence_catalog.limits: Provider validation, complete deployment, scoped capability enforcement, restore drills, and live IAM denial checks are pending.

evidence_catalog.title: Public-source hygiene
evidence_catalog.observed: The prior publication pass reported a scan of 107 history blobs with no common secret patterns and no tracked large dataset/weight files.
evidence_catalog.limits: A pattern scan is not a universal secrecy guarantee; no persistent raw scan report or runtime/image secret-canary campaign is claimed.

evidence_catalog.title: Observed live A100 container/GCS probe
evidence_catalog.observed: Vertex job 5919343314829574144 succeeded on one A100, ran a generic CUDA MLP/checkpoint probe, and verified GCS read/write for the recorded old digest. Two T4 attempts were canceled and confirmed terminal.
evidence_catalog.limits: Source cbf9dd1 predates the DINOv3 fix; no pretrained DINOv3, current image, full CertifiedRuntime, deployed platform, or measured final bill is established. These are retained observations, not a fresh cloud retest.

evidence_catalog.title: Current local suite and acceptance boundaries
evidence_catalog.observed: The unchanged implementation at dbc04a3 was rerun for this document: 55 passed, no skips, two dependency deprecation warnings, 5.62 seconds.
evidence_catalog.limits: A green local suite is a partial result. Complete deployed flow and live prevention acceptance remain incomplete.

requirements.title: One supervised classification purpose
requirements.requirement: The system shall train and serve supervised DINOv3 plus MLP defect classifiers for already identified, single-label defect crops.
requirements.what: A crop receives one canonical defect class; product disposition remains a consuming-system decision.
requirements.why: Keep the platform focused on the user's single training objective.
requirements.how: Declare the input/output contract and expose only supported training and prediction operations.
requirements.positive: Train one labeled crop dataset and obtain class, confidence, review flag, and optional diagnostic heatmap.
requirements.negative: Forbidden: an accepted request silently becomes detection, segmentation, multilabel training, or product disposition. Submit each unsupported task; validation must reject it before dataset publication or a paid job.
requirements.current: E-SCOPE and E-TRAIN support the chosen path. Negative task-mode rejection is not comprehensively tested.
requirements.owner: Project owner and primary integration owner

requirements.title: Separate object models
requirements.requirement: The system shall isolate datasets, experiments, model names, and approved releases by object type.
requirements.what: Each object has its own canonical class list and classifier lineage.
requirements.why: Avoid mixing incompatible defects or deploying one object's classifier for another.
requirements.how: Carry object identity through typed records, artifact prefixes, registry names, and serving deployment checks.
requirements.positive: Run two object projects with different class lists and verify their artifacts and predictions remain distinct.
requirements.negative: Forbidden: a dataset, checkpoint, model version, or release from object A is accepted for object B. Attempt each cross-object substitution; all must be rejected without changing B's run or live release.
requirements.current: E-DATA and E-CONTROL include object checks; complete cross-object and live serving evidence remains open.
requirements.owner: Project owner and primary integration owner

requirements.title: Deterministic execution authority
requirements.requirement: The system shall give the runtime control plane exclusive authority over admission, job submission, waiting, retries, state, and result collection.
requirements.what: The agent supplies setup suggestions; it does not become a long-running execution controller.
requirements.why: Training must continue without agent token consumption or an active conversation.
requirements.how: Use durable run storage and GCP Workflows with narrow authenticated adapters; provide the agent no operational submit or polling capability.
requirements.positive: Submit a reviewed draft, close the agent session, and verify runtime-owned execution reaches its recorded terminal outcome.
requirements.negative: Forbidden: an agent directly launches, polls, cancels, or advances a paid run outside the control plane. Attempt via every enabled agent tool and credential; deny operations and prove no unauthorized cloud event occurred.
requirements.current: E-CONTROL tests adapter behavior; E-WORKFLOW is inspected configuration only. Live agent absence and capability-denial proof is pending.
requirements.owner: Project owner and primary integration owner

requirements.title: Suggestions require validated facts
requirements.requirement: The system shall treat model-generated setup and label suggestions as proposals until deterministic validation and required human review accept them.
requirements.what: Agent text never establishes source existence, certification, label truth, permission, or budget authority.
requirements.why: Prevent plausible generated content from becoming unverified execution input.
requirements.how: Separate draft and accepted records; validate schemas and source evidence; retain explicit review decisions.
requirements.positive: Show a suggested mapping, accept it through review, and record the accepted mapping and reviewer with the dataset.
requirements.negative: Forbidden: a fabricated URI, certification, approval, or label becomes accepted solely because the agent asserts it. Inject such suggestions and instructions; admission must fail or require unresolved human review.
requirements.current: E-SETUP and E-DATA provide partial local evidence. Suggestion provenance and all authority-bypass cases are pending.
requirements.owner: Project owner and primary integration owner

requirements.title: Human release authority
requirements.requirement: The system shall require an explicit authenticated human approval before promoting or rolling back a served model.
requirements.what: Training completion can create a candidate, while live release changes require a separate authorized decision.
requirements.why: Protect consumers from automatically deploying an unevaluated or unintended model.
requirements.how: Use protected release commands, verified approver identity, an immutable approval record, and deployment permissions separate from training.
requirements.positive: Approve one staged candidate and verify the recorded approver, selected version, and active serving response.
requirements.negative: Forbidden: training success, an LLM statement, an empty or spoofed name, or an unauthorized caller changes the live model. Attempt each route and verify alias, ledger, and serving revision remain unchanged.
requirements.current: E-RELEASE tests missing approver and staging checks locally. Authenticated identity binding and live IAM denial remain open.
requirements.owner: Project owner and primary integration owner

requirements.title: Truthful acceptance
requirements.requirement: The system shall distinguish implementation, local test success, live infrastructure success, and full system acceptance.
requirements.what: A passing synthetic GPU check cannot establish pretrained DINOv3 or deployed-service acceptance.
requirements.why: Keep readiness claims tied to actual observations.
requirements.how: Record claim scope, source and image identity, evidence tier, timestamps, and unmet gates in the acceptance register.
requirements.positive: For the existing A100 result, show only its GPU/GCS scope and the remaining DINOv3, registry, serving, and telemetry gates.
requirements.negative: Forbidden: absent evidence, a mock, or a passing check for another image produces a full acceptance claim. Try promoting each evidence record's scope; the acceptance validator or reviewer must reject the unsupported claim.
requirements.current: E-ACCEPTANCE documents the distinction. Automated claim-scope enforcement is not implemented.
requirements.owner: Project owner and primary integration owner

requirements.title: Accept an object brief
requirements.requirement: The setup interface shall accept object details, notes, unstructured text, image locations, and label-source locations.
requirements.what: Provide a guided CLI entry point for a new object project.
requirements.why: Reduce the need to write program code.
requirements.how: Parse input into a typed draft; retain the supplied brief as evidence.
requirements.positive: Enter a brief containing all supported input types; inspect the resulting draft and preserved source text.
requirements.negative: Supply malformed locations or missing facts; they remain unresolved and cannot become a runnable configuration.
requirements.current: E-SETUP: CLI and typed draft exist; complete input-preservation coverage is pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Bound clarification
requirements.requirement: The assistant shall ask concise questions only for missing or conflicting facts, within a configurable question-round limit.
requirements.what: A few questions produce a reviewable configuration.
requirements.why: Keep setup understandable and predictable.
requirements.how: Track unresolved fields and asked questions; end the configured rounds with a draft or explicit unresolved items.
requirements.positive: Exercise a complete brief and an incomplete brief; verify only necessary questions and the configured round bound.
requirements.negative: Repeated or adversarial responses cannot cause an unbounded question loop or bypass unresolved required fields.
requirements.current: E-SETUP: current CLI uses up to three rounds; configurable bounds and loop prevention need evidence.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Use configurable LiteLLM
requirements.requirement: The assistant shall use a configured LiteLLM provider, model, and credentials without embedding endpoints or secrets in source.
requirements.what: Setup intelligence is replaceable through configuration.
requirements.why: Support endpoints that are not yet available.
requirements.how: Validate provider settings and use secret references; separate assistant failure from operational state.
requirements.positive: Use a test provider to obtain a valid draft; replace the endpoint without source edits.
requirements.negative: Missing credentials, invalid JSON, timeouts, or unavailable providers cannot start a job or invent a completed draft.
requirements.current: E-SETUP: typed parsing and missing-model errors exist; timeout and secret-handling proof is pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Review the proposed configuration
requirements.requirement: The system shall show the object, classes, sources, dataset policy, runtime, hardware, estimate, and unresolved items before accepting a runnable plan.
requirements.what: Expose what will run in plain language.
requirements.why: Let a human correct consequential interpretation errors.
requirements.how: Render a template from validated records; bind acceptance to a configuration fingerprint.
requirements.positive: Inspect the review and accept it; the stored fingerprint equals the displayed configuration.
requirements.negative: Change a reviewed field before submission; stale acceptance cannot authorize the changed plan.
requirements.current: E-SETUP/E-CONTROL: draft and submission fingerprints exist; review-to-admission binding is pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Review label exceptions
requirements.requirement: The system shall require human decisions for unresolved, ambiguous, or conflicting labels before publishing a dataset.
requirements.what: Suggestions assist review; accepted labels are explicit.
requirements.why: Avoid silently training on guessed labels.
requirements.how: Present raw label, context, suggested mapping, and reason; persist reviewer and decisions.
requirements.positive: Resolve an exception and verify the accepted mapping and reviewer in provenance.
requirements.negative: Unanswered, conflicting, or assistant-only decisions cannot produce an accepted dataset version.
requirements.current: E-DATA: unresolved labels block builds; review evidence is pinned locally; authenticated review remains pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

observed_checks.claim: Unresolved labels cause local builder rejection.
observed_checks.limits: Rejection is asserted; a complete independent no-publication state audit is not asserted.

requirements.title: Preserve actionable review
requirements.requirement: The system shall provide a review artifact that a non-programmer can inspect and return with decisions.
requirements.what: Provide readable exception rows and decision instructions.
requirements.why: Make the review usable outside a chat session.
requirements.how: Generate stable item IDs, allowed decisions, instructions, and a validated import format.
requirements.positive: Export, edit, and import a review; every decision resolves the intended item.
requirements.negative: Duplicate decisions, unknown IDs, or altered source bindings cannot silently resolve another item.
requirements.current: E-DATA: preview reports exist; full round-trip review and tamper checks are not established.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Recover setup interruptions
requirements.requirement: The system shall save drafts and accepted review decisions so setup can resume without losing completed work.
requirements.what: Resume after terminal or provider interruption.
requirements.why: Prevent repetition and inconsistent decisions.
requirements.how: Persist revisioned drafts and validate source fingerprints on resume.
requirements.positive: Interrupt setup after review; resume with the same decisions and unresolved items.
requirements.negative: A stale draft cannot overwrite a newer accepted revision or apply decisions to changed evidence.
requirements.current: E-SETUP: durable draft revision and resume guarantees are pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Automatically admit an eligible plan
requirements.requirement: The system shall automatically start runtime execution after setup acceptance only when all admission gates pass.
requirements.what: A valid reviewed plan progresses without additional agent waiting.
requirements.why: Deliver the requested simple interface.
requirements.how: Invoke deterministic admission using validated sources, accepted labels, usable certification, and trusted budget policy.
requirements.positive: Accept an eligible fixture plan; receive a run ID and observe runtime dispatch.
requirements.negative: A single failed or unknown gate prevents paid submission; no separate hidden path bypasses admission.
requirements.current: E-CONTROL: several admission gates are tested locally; complete guided-to-runtime flow is pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Explain progress and required action
requirements.requirement: The interface shall display current status, next action, evidence locations, and failures in plain language.
requirements.what: Users can find and understand their run.
requirements.why: Avoid requiring cloud-console or code knowledge for routine navigation.
requirements.how: Generate summaries from authoritative records with CLI list, status, and location commands.
requirements.positive: Find a run by object and ID; follow dataset, model, logs, and failure links.
requirements.negative: Missing evidence or unknown state cannot be displayed as success, approval, or a verified artifact.
requirements.current: E-SETUP/E-CONTROL: navigation commands exist; complete truthful-display tests are pending.
requirements.owner: Setup/CLI service and dataset reviewer

requirements.title: Strict typed records
requirements.requirement: The platform shall validate typed object, source, dataset, experiment, Vertex job, certified runtime, run, and release records.
requirements.what: Use explicit contracts across every subsystem.
requirements.why: Prevent shape drift and ambiguous defaults.
requirements.how: Version schemas; reject unknown fields and invalid values at each ingress.
requirements.positive: Round-trip every record and validate documented examples.
requirements.negative: Unknown fields, invalid enums, duplicate classes, or invalid split fractions cannot enter accepted records.

requirements.requirement: The platform shall separate runtime software, experiment settings, hardware/job settings, and environment endpoints.
requirements.what: Change an experiment without changing its runtime image.
requirements.why: Keep reproducibility and ownership clear.
requirements.how: Use independent validated files and fingerprints; document permitted changes per role.
requirements.positive: Change epochs or GPU count; retain the exact image digest while updating the correct record.

requirements.why: Avoid coupling the repository to one environment.

requirements.why: Make projects navigable by non-programmers.
requirements.how: Record template version; validate generated folder and file shapes.

requirements.why: Keep cloud artifacts discoverable without duplicating them locally.

requirements.what: Reconstruct exactly what was requested.
requirements.why: Make later edits unable to rewrite history.
requirements.how: Write immutable snapshots before execution and include their checksums in lineage.
requirements.positive: Reproduce configuration from a historical run after editing current defaults.
requirements.negative: Editing defaults or templates cannot alter a historical accepted snapshot.

requirements.why: Prevent hidden environment or legacy-file behavior.

requirements.why: Prevent drift between documented and actual interfaces.
